block.document_search.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.document_search.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.document_search.model.title: Document Search
block.document_search.model.description: Search a persistent local text corpus and return relevant excerpts with their source references.
block.document_search.help_corpus: Independent local corpus in this block's persistent storage. Inputs cannot select another corpus.
block.document_search.help_match_mode: Literal text search: all words, any word, or a consecutive phrase. No raw query language or semantic model.
block.document_search.help_max_results: Maximum returned excerpts. Scores rank this query; they are not confidence probabilities.
block.document_search.help_max_documents: Maximum retained identities, including removal tombstones that protect against stale revisions. No automatic eviction.
block.document_search.help_max_sections: Maximum indexed sections in this corpus.
block.document_search.help_max_character: Total stored text character limit. A batch is accepted or rejected atomically.
block.document_search.help_max_input_byt: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per input event.
block.document_search.help_timeout_sec: One deadline per event, including a bounded database lock wait.
